1167-a-strange-disappearance.title: A Strange Disappearance
1167-a-strange-disappearance.creator: Anna Katharine Green
1167-a-strange-disappearance.description: A book by Anna Katharine Green. I shrugged my shoulders and beckoned to Mr. Gryce who was just then passing. She at once seemed to put confidence in him. Drawing him aside, she whispered a few low eager words which I could not hear. He listened nonchalantly for a moment but suddenly made a move which I knew indicated strong and surprised interest, though from his face--but you know what Gryce’s face is.

47170-a-select-collection-of-old-english.description: A book by W. Carew Hazlitt.. PERVERSE DOCTRINE, _an old Popish Priest_. IGNORANCE, _another, but elder_. NEW CUSTOM, _a Minister_. LIGHT OF THE GOSPEL, _a Minister_. HYPOCRISY, _an old Woman_. CRUELTY, _a Ruffler_.[1]  AVARICE, _a Ruffler_. EDIFICATION, _a Sage_. ASSURANCE, _a Virtue_. GOD'S FELICITY, _a Sage_.

arxiv-2109-02087.title: Correspondence of Donaldson-Thomas and Gopakumar-Vafa invariants on local Calabi-Yau 4-folds over V 5 V_{5} and V 22 V_{22}
arxiv-2109-02087.creator: Kiryong Chung, Sanghyeon Lee, Joonyeong Won
arxiv-2109-02087.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kiryong Chung, Sanghyeon Lee, Joonyeong Won. We compute Gromov-Witten (GW) and Donaldson-Thomas (DT) invariants (and also descendant invariants) for local CY 4 4 -folds over Fano 3 3 -folds, V 5 V_{5} and V 22 V_{22} up to degree 3 3 . We use torus localization for GW invariants computation, and use classical results for Hilbert schemes on V 5 V_{5} and V 22 V_{22} for DT invariants computation.

arxiv-2404-03141.title: The Role of Torsion in Trans-Planckian Physics
arxiv-2404-03141.creator: Elham Arabahmadi, Siamak Akhshabi
arxiv-2404-03141.description: Abstract The torsion of spacetime, if it exists, plays an important role at the very early universe, when the spin density of particles was very high. It is generally believed that in the extremely high energies of the early universe a new physics called trans-Planckian physics should be considered.

arxiv-2407-18410.creator: Igor Khavkine, David McNutt, Lode Wylleman

arxiv-2502-11831.title: Intuitive physics understanding emerges from self-supervised pretraining on natural videos
arxiv-2502-11831.creator: Quentin Garrido, Nicolas Ballas, Mahmoud Assran, Adrien Bardes, Laurent Najman, Michael Rabbat, Emmanuel Dupoux, Yann LeCun
arxiv-2502-11831.description: Abstract We investigate the emergence of intuitive physics understanding in general-purpose deep neural network models trained to predict masked regions in natural videos. Leveraging the violation-of-expectation framework, we find that video prediction models trained to predict outcomes in a learned representation space demonstrate an understanding of various intuitive physics properties, such as object permanence and shape consistency.

arxiv-2504-02987.title: Model Combination in Risk Sharing under Ambiguity
arxiv-2504-02987.creator: Emma Kroell, Sebastian Jaimungal, Silvana M. Pesenti
arxiv-2504-02987.description: Abstract We consider the problem of an agent who faces losses in continuous time over a finite time horizon and may choose to share some of these losses with a counterparty. The agent is uncertain about the true loss distribution and has multiple models for the losses, characterized by a finite set of probability measures.

arxiv-2505-02061.title: DIFFEOMORPHIC RECONSTRUCTION OF A 2D-SIMPLE NON-PARAMETRIC MANIFOLD FROM A NOISY LEVEL SET DATA VIA SHAPE GRADIENTS
arxiv-2505-02061.creator: Shafeequdheen P, Jyotiranjan Nayak, Vijayakrishna Rowthu
arxiv-2505-02061.description: Abstract . A variational approach to the reconstruction of a shape (2D simple manifolds) as triangulated surface from given level set using shape gradients is presented. It involves an energy functional that depends on the local shape characteristics of the surface.

pmc-10486102.title: Review on infection control strategies to minimize outbreaks of the emerging pathogen Elizabethkingia anophelis
pmc-10486102.creator: Lisa Mallinckrodt, Robert Huis in ’t Veld, Sigrid Rosema, Andreas Voss, Erik Bathoorn
pmc-10486102.description: BackgroundElizabethkingia anophelis is a multi-drug resistant emerging opportunistic pathogen with a high mortality rate, causing healthcare-associated outbreaks worldwide.MethodsWe report a case of E. anophelis pleuritis, resulting from transmission through lung transplantation, followed by a literature review of outbreak reports and strategies to minimize E. anophelis transmission in healthcare settings.ResultsFrom 1990 to August 2022, 14 confirmed E.

pmc-11345284.title: PD-1 inhibitor in the treatment of relapsed primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma follow up by 18F-FDG PET/CT: A case report and literature review
pmc-11345284.creator: ChiIeng Tou, LinFeng Ma
pmc-11345284.description: Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma (PMBCL) is a specific subtype of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), which occurs more frequently in young women. PMBCL is an uncommon kind of cancer. R-EPOCH is a common therapeutic regimen that is suitable for patients with PMBCL, and could get a relatively high complete remission rate.

pmc-11450625.title: Clinical and financial significance of insomnia within a large payor-provider health system
pmc-11450625.creator: Bradley E Karlin, Ryan J Anderson, Jillian M Rung, Charlotte Drury-Gworek, Tyson S Barrett
pmc-11450625.description: Study ObjectivesInsomnia has profound negative effects on behavioral health, physical health, and functional domains. Leveraging claims data from one of the nation’s largest payor-provider systems, the current study examined the real-world prevalence of insomnia, comorbidity of insomnia with behavioral health and other sleep disorders, and the impact of insomnia on total health care costs.

pmc-11632098.title: Rationally designed laterally-condensed-catalysts deliver robust activity and selectivity for ethylene production in acetylene hydrogenation
pmc-11632098.creator: Zehua Li, Eylül Öztuna, Katarzyna Skorupska, Olga V. Vinogradova, Afshan Jamshaid, Alexander Steigert, Christian Rohner, Maria Dimitrakopoulou, Mauricio J. Prieto, Christian Kunkel, Matus Stredansky, Pierre Kube, Michael Götte, Alexandra M. Dudzinski, Frank Girgsdies, Sabine Wrabetz, Wiebke Frandsen
pmc-11632098.description: Future carbon management strategies require storage in elemental form, achievable through a sequence of CO2 hydrogenation reactions. Hydrogen is recycled from molecular intermediates by dehydrogenation, and side product acetylene selectively hydrogenated to ethylene. Existing Pd alloy catalysts for gas purification underperform in concentrated feeds, necessitating novel concepts.

pmc-12399673.title: Dual vs. isolated anti-Ro antibody positivity in rheumatoid arthritis
pmc-12399673.creator: Yan Ma, Chaoyu Gu, Qianqian Li, Liangjing Lu
pmc-12399673.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the clinical and immunological significance of anti-Ro52/TRIM21 and anti-Ro60/SSA antibodies in rheumatoid arthritis (RA), particularly the association of dual antibody positivity with disease severity, systemic manifestations, and therapeutic resistance.MethodsWe conducted a cohort study involving 670 RA patients, stratified into four groups according to anti-Ro52 and anti-Ro60 antibody status: Ro52+/Ro60+, Ro52+/Ro60−, Ro52−/Ro60+, and Ro52−/Ro60−.

pmc-12415531.title: A new paradigm for valorization of waste poly(glycolic acid): facile coupling with epoxides and synthesis of copolyesters with enhanced performance
pmc-12415531.creator: Feng Ren, Zhuangzhuang Liang, Yifan Jia, Bokun Li, Zhiqiang Sun, Chenyang Hu, Xuan Pang, Xuesi Chen
pmc-12415531.description: Poly(glycolic acid) (PGA) is one of the most widely used biodegradable polyesters, but its efficient valorization presents a long-standing challenge. Herein, we report the first facile PGA valorization strategy by utilizing epoxides to upcycle PGA into fused lactones under mild conditions (<100 °C), and subsequent copolymerization to produce copolyesters with wide potential tunability and enhanced performance.

pmc-12450929.title: Learning curve of ultrasound-guided caudal epidural block: a CUSUM pivotal analysis
pmc-12450929.creator: Dongmei Ma, Ping Chen, Jianhong Xu
pmc-12450929.description: Background and objectivesThis study aims to dynamically evaluate the learning curve of anesthesiology residents’ mastery of ultrasound-guided caudal epidural block (US-CEB) through cumulative summation (CUSUM) analysis, providing a quantitative basis for optimizing the training program.MethodsAfter ethical approval and registration, 10 novice anesthesiology residents underwent standardized training in US-CEB.

pmc-12465338.title: Leveraging multigenerational health data to enhance mental disorder risk prediction: a population-based cohort study
pmc-12465338.creator: Amani F. Hamad, Barret A. Monchka, James M. Bolton, Leslie L. Roos, Mohamed Elgendi, Lisa M. Lix
pmc-12465338.description: BackgroundMental disorders are highly prevalent, and comorbidities between physical and mental health conditions are common. Physical comorbidities and family health histories may improve the accuracy of mental disorder risk prediction. We developed prediction models for mental disorder risk using comprehensive individual and family mental and physical health histories.

pmc-12559521.title: Willingness to Pay for Improved Quality of Services from Informal Health Providers in Urban Slums in Nigeria
pmc-12559521.creator: Obinna Onwujekwe, Godwin Uche Ezema, Chukwudi Nwokolo, Chinyere Ojiugo Mbachu
pmc-12559521.description: IntroductionThe shortage of formal healthcare providers in urban slums has resulted in the widespread presence of untrained informal healthcare providers (IHPs), who often deliver low-quality services. Integrating these IHPs into the formal healthcare system through capacity-building initiatives could enhance the quality of services offered to clients.

pmc-12696709.title: Statistical and machine learning approaches for identifying biomarker associations in respiratory diseases in a population-specific region
pmc-12696709.creator: Meshari Alazmi, Amer AlGhadhban, Abdulaziz Almalaq, Kamaleldin B. Said, Yazeed Faden
pmc-12696709.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The growing interest in utilizing clinical blood biomarkers for non-invasive diagnostics has transformed the approach to early detection and prognosis of respiratory diseases. Biomarker-driven diagnostics offer cost-effective, rapid, and scalable alternatives to traditional imaging and clinical assessments. In this study, we conducted a retrospective analysis of 913 patients from a local respiratory clinic in Hail region, evaluating the diagnostic relevance of 15 blood biomarkers across four respiratory conditions: COVID-19, pneumonia, asthma, and other complications.

pmc-12698376.title: Alpha-lipoic acid ameliorates nab-paclitaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy by inhibiting IL-17 signaling pathway
pmc-12698376.creator: Hong Sun, Yuxin Cai, Ling Li, Xiu Xin, Jingchao Yan, Taomin Huang
pmc-12698376.description: BackgroundThe precise mechanisms by which alpha-lipoic acid (LA) alleviates nab-paclitaxel (nab-PTX)-induced peripheral neuropathy have yet to be fully elucidated. The objective of this study was to investigate the mechanisms underlying the neuroprotective effects of LA in mitigating nab-PTX-induced peripheral neuropathy.MethodsWe established a rat model of nab-PTX-induced peripheral neuropathy to evaluate the efficacy of LA.

pmc-13002718.title: Aortic isthmus Doppler hemodynamics and ımpacts on perinatal outcomes in pregestational and gestational diabetes mellitus
pmc-13002718.creator: Zeynep Seyhanli, Gulsan Karabay, Ahmet Arif Filiz, Dilara Duygulu Bulan, Recep Taha Agaoglu, Gizem Aktemur, Betul Tokgoz Cakir, Kadriye Yakut Yucel, Zehra Vural Yilmaz
pmc-13002718.description: Background/AimTo assess the sensitivity of the fetal aortic isthmus (AoI) Doppler changes in predicting the adverse perinatal outcome with pregestational and gestational diabetes mellitus compared with other Doppler parameters.Materials and methodsThis prospective case–control study was undertaken between Agust 2023 and May 2024 in Ankara Etlik City Hospital perinatology department.

pmc-13154637.title: Feasibility and Impact of Invasive Coronary Function Testing in Ischemia and No Obstructive Coronary Arteries: A Single-Center Study
pmc-13154637.creator: Deeksha Acharya, Yulith Roca Alvarez, Bruce Samuels, Janet Wei, Ana Iribarren, Galen Cook-Wiens, Paulina Skaff, Sachini Ranasinghe, Jenna Maughan, Mamoo Nakamura, Tarun Chakravarty, Aakriti Gupta, Babak Azarbal, C. Noel Bairey Merz, Martha Gulati
pmc-13154637.description: BackgroundIn patients with suspected ischemia and no obstructive coronary arteries (INOCA), coronary function testing (CFT) helps identify underlying endotypes. Despite guideline support, adoption of CFT remains limited. This study assessed the feasibility of CFT and its impact on medical management.MethodsThis single-center, prospective study (2020-2025) evaluated CFT implementation and subsequent medication changes in patients with clinically indicated CFT.

pmc-13179005.title: An Unusual Cause of Shoulder Pain: Sternoclavicular Joint Septic Arthritis
pmc-13179005.creator: Jennifer J Price, George Shahin
pmc-13179005.description: Septic arthritis of the sternoclavicular joint (SCJ) is an uncommon location of septic joint infection and is often a diagnostic challenge. Patients may present with insidious, vague symptoms, such as chest pain or shoulder pain, and imaging modalities are often nonspecific, leading to a delay in diagnosis and treatment.

pmc-13264468.title: Comprehensive Biophysical Profiling Evidences Self‐Oligomerization of Bacterially Expressed Pc Protein
pmc-13264468.creator: Maria Zahid, Sabin Prajapati, Ghazaleh Alamdari, Kai Tittmann, Selin Kara
pmc-13264468.description: Polycomb (Pc) protein is a core component of Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 (PRC1) and plays a central role in epigenetic gene silencing, particularly during embryo development. Despite extensive functional characterization, structural understanding of Pc remains limited due to its intrinsic disorder, low sequence complexity, and propensity for dynamic self‐association.

pmc-13295994.title: Primary care use among adults with eating disorders in England: a population-based cohort study using electronic health records
pmc-13295994.creator: Jessica Wilkins, Lucy Gallagher, Karina L Allen, Alexandru Dregan, Chloe Gao, Jamie Scuffell, Ulrike Schmidt

pmc-13347882.title: Identification of immune and ferroptosis-related gene cysteine dioxygenase type 1 (CDO1) as a prognostic biomarker in colorectal cancer, relating to immunotherapy response distinction
pmc-13347882.creator: Shuo Chen, Mingyue Xu, Weijun Su, Kai Wang, Siqi Zhang, Xipeng Zhang, Lin Zhang
pmc-13347882.description: BackgroundColorectal cancer (CRC) is the third most common cause of cancer deaths worldwide, and has a poor prognosis in advanced stages. Whereas there are limited effective biomarkers of CRC. Herein, we aimed to explore the potential prognostic value of immune and ferroptosis-related genes (IFRGs).MethodsCRC-related data were extracted from the Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) databases.

pmc-13506582.title: Molecular detection and zoonotic genotyping of Enterocytozoon bieneusi in Siberian tigers (Panthera tigris altaica), Northeast China
pmc-13506582.creator: Hang Tian, Zhiying Cui, Zhiyou Lv, Mengqiu Liu, Yang Liu, Yilin Zhao, Weiyan Yin, Mengru Zhao, Hongyan Yu, Mengchao Zhou, Yaxian Lu, Dapeng Li, Ming Gong, Haitao Xu, Zhijun Hou

pmc-13596815.title: Monte Carlo modeling of the formation and organization of ion channel clustering
pmc-13596815.creator: Nicolae Moise, Seth H. Weinberg
pmc-13596815.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The spatial organization of ion channels on cell membranes critically influences many key physiological processes, such as cardiac and neuronal excitability and cellular signaling, yet the mechanisms governing channel clustering remain poorly understood. In this study, we present a stochastic computational framework that models the dynamic organization of ion channels through Monte Carlo simulations incorporating membrane insertion, removal, channel-channel interactions, and diffusion processes. Our model reveals several fundamental principles of membrane domain formation.
